title: Elementary and Secondary School Counseling Act
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.
summary:
Elementary and Secondary School Counseling Act

This bill directs the Department of Education to award formula grants to states and, through them, subgrants to local educational agencies to increase access to school-based, mental-health-services providers at high-need public elementary and secondary schools.
